caption: Orvieto Cathedral, Orvieto
composition: Gothic mosaic façade on the hilltop piazza · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: The camera stands on the piazza facing Orvieto Cathedral's soaring Gothic facade in the soft light of the 07:21 morning. Gilded mosaics glitter across the gabled panels between the slender pinnacled towers, the great rose window glowing at center, while the striped black-and-white masonry of the side wall shows at the right edge. Modest town rooftops and cypress trees fill the lower left, and the pale dawn sky warms to pink behind the hilltop silhouette.
